children: Estée Lauder appointed Justin Boxford to a new role of global president, luxury beauty brands.
The move comes ahead of the retirement of Sandra Main, currently president of the La Mer and skin care brands. Boxford's portfolio will expand to include La Mer in his new role, the company said.

Estée Lauder also promoted Erica Kwok to general manager of its flagship Estée Lauder brand, and said Magalie Parksuwan will oversee Darphin Paris and Lab Series while continuing on as general manager of La Mer.
"These appointments reflect the exceptional strength of our leadership bench and our deep commitment to developing world-class talent from within," said Chief Brand Officer Jane Hertzmark Hudis.
